capabilities: Synchronize existing child notes with changes to their declared template
Three-way merge template, baseline, and child content to keep child-only edits
Statically project Templater output without executing template code
Preview projected template defaults and unresolved expressions
Report per-note property, heading, and body-text changes after manual updates
extras: Automatic updates are off by default; the README advises enabling File Recovery and backing up the vault before the first large synchronization, and documents a manual ID migration from dynamically-updating-templates.
intentEvidence: It supports ordinary Markdown templates used by the core Templates plugin
problem: Obsidian templates only apply when a note is created, so later edits to a template never propagate to notes already made from it.
